in_marathi.name: Premalatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Love of the God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Premalatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Premalatha is a beautiful name derived from the Tamil and Sanskrit languages. The name Premalatha means 'Love of the God'. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hinduism and is associated with love, beauty, and devotion.
